title: Anthropic and the Gates Foundation pledge $200M to use AI in health and education initiatives; the foundation signed a similar, $50M deal with OpenAI in January (Jeffrey Dastin/Reuters)
summary: Jeffrey Dastin / Reuters: Anthropic and the Gates Foundation pledge $200M to use AI in health and education initiatives; the foundation signed a similar, $50M deal with OpenAI in January — Anthropic and the Gates Foundation have pledged $200 million to back artificial intelligence-related public goods …
